decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - By reason of its combined excessive width, height, depth and design including flat-roofed form, the proposed first-floor rear/side extension would result in an unsympathetic form of overdevelopment that would fail to respect the appearance and character of the original building, and would appear as a visually discordant addition that harms the character and appearance of the streetscene. The development therefore fails to achieve high quality design and would be contrary to in particular, Merton Local Plan (2024) D12.3 and D12.4.

Reason : 2 - By reason of its combined height, depth and siting, the two storey side extension and first floor rear/side extension would result in a visually intrusive and overbearing form of development that would result in an unacceptable sense of enclosure and potential loss of daylight/sunlight to the detriment of the residential amenity of nearby occupants, in particular, no 78 Claremont Avenue. The proposal is contrary to, in particular, Policies D12.3 and D12.4 of the Merton Local Plan (2024).

Reason : 3 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the NPPF, The London Borough of Merton  (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to development proposals focused on solutions. LBM works with applicants/agents in a positive and proactive manner by:
"	Offering a pre-application advice and duty desk service. 
"	Where possible, suggesting solutions to secure a successful outcome.
"	As appropriate, updating applicants/agents of any issues that may arise in the processing of their application.
In this instance:
"	The application was not considered to comply with the provisions of the Development Plan and NPPF as submitted, and would have required substantial changes such that a new application would be required. 
"	The applicant is advised to seek pre-application advice on any resubmission.
